0.9.139.title: Compass Beta 0.9.139
0.9.139.intro: TorBox Direct: TorBox-cached streams without a scraper addon, faster TorBox cache checks, and Trakt sign-in on its new address.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: TorBox Direct. With a TorBox key, Compass now finds releases already cached on TorBox by itself, even with no stream addon installed. They appear in the list as [TB⚡] TorBox Direct.
TorBox cache checks are much faster: hundreds of releases are checked in one request instead of dozens.
Trakt sign-in uses Trakt's new login address.

sections.heading: TorBox Direct
items: Turns on by itself when a TorBox API key is set in Settings, Streaming, Services. There is nothing else to set up.
Searches public release indexes for the movie or episode you open, then keeps only what is already cached on your TorBox account. Every result plays instantly.
Your TorBox key never leaves the connection to TorBox. The public indexes only receive the title and IMDb ID.
More 4K releases and season packs are found.
Anime with absolute episode numbers (for example One Piece - 1150) is matched to the right episode.
Reopening a title is faster: the search is reused for a few minutes, while TorBox availability is checked fresh every time.

sections.heading: Trakt
items: Signing in to Trakt now uses auth.trakt.tv. Trakt stops accepting logins on the old address on 1 February 2027, so update before then to keep signing in.
You stay signed in; nothing changes for accounts that are already connected.

ar.title: Compass بيتا 0.9.139
ar.intro: TorBox Direct: مصادر من كاش TorBox بدون إضافة بحث، وفحص أسرع لكاش TorBox، وتسجيل دخول Trakt على عنوانه الجديد.

sections.heading: أبرز ما في التحديث
items: TorBox Direct. مع مفتاح TorBox، صار Compass يلقى بنفسه الإصدارات الموجودة في كاش TorBox، حتى لو ما عندك أي إضافة مصادر. تظهر في القائمة باسم [TB⚡] TorBox Direct.
فحص كاش TorBox صار أسرع بكثير: مئات الإصدارات تنفحص بطلب واحد بدل عشرات الطلبات.
تسجيل الدخول إلى Trakt يستخدم عنوان الدخول الجديد من Trakt.

sections.heading: TorBox Direct
items: يشتغل تلقائياً لما يكون مفتاح TorBox مضاف في الإعدادات ← البث ← الخدمات. ما يحتاج أي إعداد ثاني.
يبحث في فهارس الإصدارات العامة عن الفيلم أو الحلقة اللي تفتحها، ويبقي بس اللي موجود أصلاً في كاش حسابك على TorBox. كل النتائج تشتغل فوراً.
مفتاح TorBox ما يروح لأي جهة غير TorBox. الفهارس العامة توصلها بس العنوان ورقم IMDb.
يلقى إصدارات 4K وحزم مواسم أكثر.
الأنمي المرقّم ترقيماً مطلقاً (مثل One Piece - 1150) ينطابق مع الحلقة الصحيحة.
إعادة فتح نفس العنوان صارت أسرع: البحث ينعاد استخدامه لدقايق، وتوفّر الإصدارات في TorBox ينفحص من جديد كل مرة.

sections.heading: Trakt
items: تسجيل الدخول إلى Trakt صار عن طريق auth.trakt.tv. Trakt بيوقف قبول الدخول من العنوان القديم في 1 فبراير 2027، فحدّث قبلها عشان تقدر تسجّل دخول.
تبقى مسجّل دخول، وما يتغيّر شي للحسابات المربوطة من قبل.

0.9.138.title: Compass Beta 0.9.138
0.9.138.intro: Playnite, Steam friends and wishlist, the finished Compass branding, and email on your Compass account.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Playnite library. Browse everything you own on Epic Games, EA app, GOG, Ubisoft Connect and Xbox, installed or not.
Steam friends and wishlist, plus uninstall through Steam.
Add an email to your Compass account, reset your password by email, and link Discord.
The Compass branding refresh: new app icons, theme previews, loader and screens.

sections.heading: Games
items: The Explore shortcuts (Enter a World, Studios & Publishers, ROM Hacks, Explore by Launcher, Updates & Events, Explore the Charts) now jump straight to their section, even when it is further down the page.
Select several .exe files when adding local games; each one is added as its own game.
Missing game logos: we are still working on some pages. If a game has no logo, tell us its name.

sections.heading: Playnite
items: Library, All Games, Playnite. Click Add the extension to Playnite, then restart Playnite once.
Installed games launch from Compass. Games that are not installed have an Install in Playnite button.
Games Compass already knows through Steam or other launchers do not appear twice.
Portable Playnite works too: select the Playnite folder.
The extension only reads your library and changes nothing in Playnite.
The Epic Games and EA app filters now include the Playnite games for that store, next to the ones installed on your system.

sections.heading: Steam
items: Uninstall from an installed game page; Steam asks you to confirm.
Friends: see who is online, who is playing, and what.
Wishlist: browse your Steam wishlist and save all of it to your saved games in one click.
Friends and Wishlist need your Steam account linked from the library.

sections.heading: Branding
items: All 17 preset app icons (Liquid Glass, Watercolor, Pixel, Blueprint, Anime Ink and more) are redrawn with the compass, each keeping its own style. If you picked a preset icon before, select it again in Settings to get the new one.
Every theme preview (Dracula, Nord, Royal, Velvet and more) shows the Compass logo and name in that theme's font.

The loader, addon installation screen, Watch Together waiting screen, Voyage and the screensaver with the cat on the boat match the new look. The TMDB setup guide and other tutorial images are updated.
The OG badge has its own artwork: an orange medal with a star. It is already live on profiles.

sections.heading: Compass account
items: Settings, Account, Compass account, Email: enter your address and open the confirmation link. To change it, click Change; the old email stays active until you confirm the new one.
Forgot password, Reset by email on the sign-in screen, so you no longer depend on the recovery key alone.

Existing accounts have 30 days to confirm an email. Compass reminds you and shows the exact deadline. After that, publishing, comments, ratings, friends and sync pause until you confirm. Watching is never affected. New accounts are asked for an email at sign-up.
Link your Discord account from the same page and join the Compass Discord server automatically.
Release news by email is off by default and only starts if you opt in.
Your email is used only for confirmation, password resets and, if you opt in, release news.
These account features need this update.

ar.title: Compass بيتا 0.9.138
ar.intro: مكتبة Playnite، وأصدقاء Steam وقائمة الأمنيات، واكتمال هوية Compass الجديدة، والبريد الإلكتروني لحساب Compass.

sections.heading: أبرز ما في التحديث
items: مكتبة Playnite. تصفّح كل ما تملكه على Epic Games وEA app وGOG وUbisoft Connect وXbox، سواء كان مثبّتاً أو لا.
أصدقاء Steam وقائمة الأمنيات، مع إلغاء التثبيت عبر Steam.
أضف بريداً إلكترونياً إلى حساب Compass، وأعد تعيين كلمة المرور بالبريد، واربط Discord.
اكتمال تحديث هوية Compass: أيقونات التطبيق ومعاينات الثيمات وشاشة التحميل وغيرها.

sections.heading: الألعاب
items: اختصارات الاستكشاف (Enter a World وStudios & Publishers وROM Hacks وExplore by Launcher وUpdates & Events وExplore the Charts) تنقلك الآن مباشرة إلى قسمها حتى لو كان أسفل الصفحة.
حدّد عدة ملفات .exe عند إضافة الألعاب المحلية، ويُضاف كل ملف كلعبة مستقلة.
شعارات الألعاب المفقودة: ما زلنا نعمل عليها في بعض الصفحات. إن كانت لعبة بلا شعار فأخبرنا باسمها.

sections.heading: Playnite
items: المكتبة ← كل الألعاب ← Playnite. اضغط «إضافة الإضافة إلى Playnite» ثم أعد تشغيل Playnite مرة واحدة.
الألعاب المثبّتة تُشغَّل من Compass، وغير المثبّتة يظهر لها زر «التثبيت في Playnite».
الألعاب التي يعرفها Compass عبر Steam أو منصات أخرى لا تظهر مرتين.
نسخ Playnite المحمولة مدعومة بتحديد مجلد Playnite.
الإضافة تقرأ مكتبتك فقط ولا تغيّر شيئاً في Playnite.
فلترا Epic Games وEA app في مكتبتك يشملان الآن ألعاب Playnite لذلك المتجر بجانب الألعاب المثبّتة على جهازك.

sections.heading: Steam
items: إلغاء التثبيت من صفحة اللعبة المثبّتة، ويتولى Steam طلب التأكيد.
الأصدقاء: من المتصل ومن يلعب وماذا يلعب.
قائمة الأمنيات: تصفّح قائمة أمنيات Steam واحفظها كلها في ألعابك المحفوظة بنقرة واحدة.
الأصدقاء وقائمة الأمنيات يتطلبان ربط حساب Steam من المكتبة.

sections.heading: الهوية
items: أعيد رسم جميع أيقونات التطبيق الجاهزة الـ17 (Liquid Glass وWatercolor وPixel وBlueprint وAnime Ink وغيرها) بالبوصلة مع الحفاظ على طابع كل أيقونة. إن كنت اخترت أيقونة جاهزة سابقاً فاخترها مرة أخرى من الإعدادات.
معاينات كل الثيمات (Dracula وNord وRoyal وVelvet وغيرها) تعرض شعار Compass واسمه بخط الثيم.
شاشة التحميل وتثبيت الإضافات وانتظار المشاهدة معاً وVoyage وشاشة التوقف بالقط على القارب تطابق الهوية الجديدة، كما حُدّثت صور شرح TMDB وبقية الشروحات.
شارة OG لها الآن رسمها الخاص: وسام برتقالي بنجمة، وهي ظاهرة في الملفات الشخصية فعلاً.

sections.heading: حساب Compass
items: الإعدادات ← الحساب ← حساب Compass ← البريد: أدخل بريدك وافتح رابط التأكيد. لتغييره اضغط «تغيير»، ويبقى البريد القديم فعّالاً حتى تؤكد الجديد.
نسيت كلمة المرور ← إعادة التعيين بالبريد في شاشة الدخول، فلا تعتمد على مفتاح الاسترداد وحده.

للحسابات الحالية 30 يوماً لتأكيد البريد، ويذكّرك Compass بالموعد الدقيق. بعد انتهائه يتوقف النشر والتعليقات والتقييمات والأصدقاء والمزامنة حتى تؤكد بريدك. المشاهدة لا تتأثر أبداً. الحسابات الجديدة تُطالَب بالبريد عند التسجيل.
اربط حساب Discord من الصفحة نفسها وانضم تلقائياً إلى سيرفر Compass.
أخبار الإصدارات بالبريد معطّلة افتراضياً ولا تعمل إلا إذا اشتركت.
يُستخدم بريدك فقط للتأكيد وإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور وأخبار الإصدارات إن اشتركت.
ميزات الحساب هذه تتطلب هذا التحديث.

0.9.137.title: Compass Beta 0.9.137
0.9.137.intro: Arabic manga built into Compass, Bingers tracking, and your data carried over from before the rename.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Arabic manga, built in. With Compass in Arabic, Manga sources has a new Compass Manga card. Get your key from manga.compass.sarl/account (sign in with your Compass account), paste it, and مانجا العاشق and AzoraFly appear in your manga section.
Bingers joins as a tracker.
Settings and library from before the app was renamed Compass carry over.

sections.heading: Compass Manga
items: One key per Compass account. The account page shows today's usage, the last 30 days, and resets the key if you need a new one.
The card checks your key before saving it, and tells you if it was mistyped or has been reset.
Sources only appear for their own language, so other languages see no change.
Locked (paid) chapters are left out of chapter lists.

sections.heading: Bingers
items: Connect your account in Settings.
Episodes and movies are marked watched on Bingers once you get through 90%. You can turn that off.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Marking something watched no longer fails silently when storage is full; Compass reports it.

ar.title: Compass بيتا 0.9.137
ar.intro: مانجا عربية مدمجة في Compass، وتتبّع عبر Bingers، وانتقال بياناتك من قبل تغيير الاسم.

sections.heading: أبرز ما في التحديث
items: مانجا عربية مدمجة. عند استخدام Compass باللغة العربية تظهر بطاقة Compass Manga الجديدة في مصادر المانجا. احصل على مفتاحك من manga.compass.sarl/account (سجّل الدخول بحساب Compass)، والصقه، فتظهر مانجا العاشق وAzoraFly في قسم المانجا.
انضمام Bingers كمتتبّع.
انتقال الإعدادات والمكتبة من قبل تغيير اسم التطبيق إلى Compass.

sections.heading: Compass Manga
items: مفتاح واحد لكل حساب Compass. تعرض صفحة الحساب استهلاك اليوم وآخر 30 يوماً، وتتيح إعادة تعيين المفتاح إذا احتجت مفتاحاً جديداً.
تتحقق البطاقة من المفتاح قبل حفظه، وتنبّهك إذا كان فيه خطأ في النسخ أو أُعيد تعيينه.
تظهر المصادر لأصحاب لغتها فقط، فلا يتغير شيء لمستخدمي اللغات الأخرى.
تُستبعد الفصول المقفلة (المدفوعة) من قوائم الفصول.

sections.heading: Bingers
items: اربط حسابك من الإعدادات.
تُعلَّم الحلقات والأفلام كمُشاهَدة على Bingers عند وصولك إلى 90% منها، ويمكنك إيقاف ذلك.

sections.heading: الإصلاحات
items: لم يعد تعليم العنصر كمُشاهَد يفشل بصمت عند امتلاء مساحة التخزين، بل يُنبّهك Compass.

0.9.136.title: Compass Beta 0.9.136
0.9.136.intro: A big feature update: right-click menus across the app, PublicMetaDB, your TorBox cloud in the Library, chapter navigation in the player, Pictorium posters, much stronger anime sync, and a new Compass look.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Right-click menus for titles, tracks, playlists, albums and artists.
PublicMetaDB joins as a tracker.
The Library opens your private TorBox cloud.
Pictorium posters, served from Compass's own server.
The player gains chapter navigation.
Anime sync lands every episode on the right cour.
Trackers stop signing you out.
Playback survives audio device changes and episode switches.
Episode ratings return.
New Compass logo and app icon.

sections.heading: Context menus
items: Quick actions on titles, Continue Watching cards, profiles and images, plus download shortcuts for episodes and titles.
Music menus for tracks, playlists, albums and artists, and the add-to-playlist picker is now a cover grid.

sections.heading: PublicMetaDB
items: Connect with your username and API key.
Watchlists show on overview pages and in the Library; resume progress syncs as you watch.
Badges appear on Continue Watching cards.

sections.heading: Library and media servers
items: Browse your private TorBox cloud and play files straight from it.
Browse server collections, pick refresh intervals, and server posters come first with TMDB as fallback.

sections.heading: Posters
items: Pictorium joins the custom poster services: paste https://pictorium.compass.sarl, or your own Pictorium link with its editor options, in Settings › Library & metadata › Custom poster service.
Series get their Pictorium posters too, and {type} in a custom poster template now reads series for shows.

sections.heading: Anime and sync
items: AniList and MAL rewatches sync, with a Count rewatches toggle.
AniList custom lists and private entries appear in your library.
Episode titles pick the best source per language and fill in from MAL and Kitsu.
Sync and Continue Watching land on the cour that aired the episode.

sections.heading: Player
items: Chapter navigation and timeline markers.
Trailer autoplay is more reliable and can use its own resolution.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: Simkl and Trakt only sign out on a true token rejection; queued Simkl watches retry on their own.
Audio device or window changes no longer interrupt playback.
A/B loops land exactly where you mark them.
Live streams stay live after a source switch.
Media server libraries no longer shrink after a short page.
Episode search no longer gets stuck on "Loading episodes…".
Discord presence: real manga covers, instant music updates, correct timestamps after seeking.
A closed console window no longer causes a false crash report on the next launch.
Add-ons page loading shows the Compass mark.
Compass services now live at compass.sarl.

ar.title: Compass بيتا 0.9.136
ar.intro: تحديث كبير بالميزات: قوائم بزر الفأرة الأيمن في كل التطبيق، دعم PublicMetaDB، سحابة TorBox الخاصة بك داخل المكتبة، التنقّل بين الفصول في المشغّل، ملصقات Pictorium، مزامنة أنمي أقوى بكثير، ومظهر جديد لـ Compass.

sections.heading: أبرز ما في التحديث
items: قوائم بزر الفأرة الأيمن للعناوين والمقاطع الموسيقية وقوائم التشغيل والألبومات والفنانين.
انضمام PublicMetaDB كخدمة تتبّع.
المكتبة تفتح سحابة TorBox الخاصة بك.
ملصقات Pictorium من خادم Compass نفسه.
المشغّل يدعم التنقّل بين الفصول.
مزامنة الأنمي تضع كل حلقة في الجزء الصحيح.
خدمات التتبّع لم تعد تسجّل خروجك.
التشغيل يستمر عند تغيير جهاز الصوت أو تبديل الحلقات.
عودة تقييمات الحلقات.
شعار Compass وأيقونة التطبيق الجديدان.

sections.heading: قوائم النقر الأيمن
items: إجراءات سريعة على العناوين وبطاقات متابعة المشاهدة والملفات الشخصية والصور، مع اختصارات لتنزيل الحلقات والعناوين.
قوائم للموسيقى تشمل المقاطع وقوائم التشغيل والألبومات والفنانين، ونافذة الإضافة إلى قائمة تشغيل أصبحت شبكة من الأغلفة.

sections.heading: PublicMetaDB
items: اربط حسابك باسم المستخدم ومفتاح API.
تظهر قوائم المشاهدة في صفحات النظرة العامة وفي المكتبة، ويُزامَن تقدّم المشاهدة أثناء التشغيل.
تظهر الشارات على بطاقات متابعة المشاهدة.

sections.heading: المكتبة وخوادم الوسائط
items: تصفّح سحابة TorBox الخاصة بك وشغّل الملفات منها مباشرة.
تصفّح مجموعات الخادم، واختر فترات التحديث، وتظهر ملصقات الخادم أولاً مع TMDB كبديل.

sections.heading: الملصقات
items: إضافة Pictorium إلى خدمات الملصقات المخصّصة: الصق https://pictorium.compass.sarl أو رابط Pictorium الخاص بك مع خيارات المحرّر، من الإعدادات ‹ المكتبة والبيانات ‹ خدمة ملصقات مخصّصة.
المسلسلات تحصل على ملصقات Pictorium أيضاً، و{type} في قالب الملصقات المخصّص يعطي series للمسلسلات.

sections.heading: الأنمي والمزامنة
items: مزامنة إعادة المشاهدة مع AniList وMAL، مع مفتاح لاحتساب إعادة المشاهدة.
تظهر قوائم AniList المخصصة والإدخالات الخاصة في مكتبتك.
عناوين الحلقات تختار المصدر الأفضل لكل لغة، وتُكمَّل من MAL وKitsu.
المزامنة ومتابعة المشاهدة تضعان الحلقة في الجزء الذي عُرضت فيه.

sections.heading: المشغّل
items: التنقّل بين الفصول وعلامات الفصول على الشريط الزمني.
التشغيل التلقائي للمقاطع الدعائية أكثر موثوقية، ويمكنه استخدام دقة خاصة به.

sections.heading: الإصلاحات
items: لا يتم تسجيل الخروج من Simkl وTrakt إلا عند رفض الرمز فعلياً، وتُعاد محاولة مشاهدات Simkl المتأخرة تلقائياً.
تغيير جهاز الصوت أو النافذة لم يعد يقطع التشغيل.
حلقات التكرار A/B تقع بالضبط حيث حدّدتها.
البث المباشر يبقى مباشراً بعد تبديل المصدر.
مكتبات خوادم الوسائط لم تعد تتقلّص بعد صفحة قصيرة.
بحث الحلقات لم يعد يعلق على «جارٍ تحميل الحلقات…».
حالة Discord: أغلفة مانغا حقيقية، وتحديث فوري للموسيقى، وأوقات صحيحة بعد التقديم.
إغلاق نافذة الطرفية لم يعد يسبّب تقرير تعطّل خاطئاً في التشغيل التالي.
شاشة تحميل صفحة الإضافات تعرض شعار Compass.
خدمات Compass أصبحت على compass.sarl.

0.9.128.title: Compass Beta 0.9.128
0.9.128.intro: The biggest beta yet: a full Sports section, a complete DJ deck, a much larger Music experience, a rebuilt Manga library with a phone remote, and a curated film canon running through discovery and detail pages, alongside a deep pass on speed, caching and reliability.

sections.heading: Sports
items: Added a full Sports section with live scores, schedules, event pages, league guides, standings and date navigation.
Added athlete profiles with career history, portraits, videos and identity matching across providers.
Added boxing schedules and fight cards, baseball, American football, motorsport, NASCAR and racing venues.
Added esports coverage with match rails, team directories, profiles, rankings, team history and map blueprints.
Added sports broadcasts with an addon source panel, stream picker, watch providers and an access gate.
Added event enrichment with boxscores, venue lineups, score detail, odds and competition metadata.
Added reminders for matches you follow, personalization, and regional coverage including Saudi league team aliases.
Added the full Sports experience to Big Picture, with its own hero, event rows, broadcast stage, chips and explore view.
A fast league now renders before a slow one instead of everything waiting for the slowest, and cached scores survive a provider outage.
A missing score stays missing and a reported zero stays zero, so old timestamps can no longer manufacture a fake live game.
One busy league can no longer crowd F1, the NBA and fight nights out of discovery, and a single fight card counts as one highlight.
Fights with unannounced opponents now show the named event rather than inventing participants.
Provider demonstration data can no longer populate a real roster or schedule, and rosters keep provider identity while de-duplicating athletes.
Stale or unrelated live race data can no longer overwrite the race you selected, and NASCAR venue matching no longer confuses similarly named cities.

sections.heading: DJ deck
items: Added a standalone DJ deck window with two decks, platter scratching with real physics, tempo sync and crossfade.
Added performance pads with several pad modes, loop controls, and an FX rack with a dedicated FX bay.
Added a live waveform display with tile-based painting, DSP analysis and motion.
Added deck audio routing, release effects and sample playback.
A deck that is not live is never adopted, so controls cannot act on the wrong deck.
A disabled equaliser no longer ships its curve, while speed changes still apply.

sections.heading: Music
items: Added Listen Together so a mix can be followed live between windows.
Added a Hatsune Miku visualizer that dances, changes expression and reacts to rhythm and tempo.
Added an animated GIF visualizer with its own decoder and settings.
Added virtual audio cable output with PulseAudio, PipeWire and CoreAudio backends for broadcasting Compass audio.
Added artist pages with galleries, rarities, linked biographies, related artists and a performance spotlight.
Added genre browsing with per-genre catalogs, scenes, insights, videos and a full set of genre artwork.
Added record label pages with label metadata and roster.
Added Billboard and Rolling Stone chart pages and rows.
Added karaoke, synced lyrics and a lyric offset control.
Added a parametric equalizer, audio metering and expanded audio settings.
Added speaker and cast output for music, plus music downloads.
Added daily mixes, made for you rows, recently played contexts and top playlists.
Added Discord Rich Presence for music.
Added playlist cover editing, artwork saving and queue continuation between sessions.
Improved music search with better ranking, scoring, multiple search lanes and fallbacks.
Two different artists who share a name no longer merge into one, and neither inherits the other's audience.
A well-known artist can no longer ride an unrelated query to the top of results, and a Cyrillic typo no longer hands the top spot to an impostor.
A song liked from a playlist still reads as liked when it plays from a different source.
The player title now sends you back to the playlist the song is actually playing from.
A song with a release tag in its title no longer loses its exact match, and titles that are only noise keep their raw form instead of vanishing.
Up next renders nothing at all when there is no next track, instead of a bare heading.
A blank lyric line now shows nothing rather than an empty scrim, and a song with no lyrics shows no overlay.
Lossy codecs such as Opus no longer inherit Hi-Res or decoder depth from a high sample rate.
A queued track keeps its place in the queue instead of being pushed to the end.

sections.heading: Manga
items: Rebuilt the Manga library with a spotlight, a home-style favorites rail, grid favorites, a section switcher and scroll-spy. — @Thunderhawkk
Added a phone remote with QR pairing, control layouts, a two-way reader settings sheet and a scroll-following strip mode. — @Thunderhawkk
Mirrored desktop reading modes on mobile and synced modes and positions in both directions. — @Thunderhawkk
Added pinch zoom, a zoom badge, a direction toggle and tap to toggle chrome in the phone reader. — @Thunderhawkk
Separated manga lists from shared lists so they have their own quota. — @Thunderhawkk
Added in-app context menus, read badges on finished chapters, and continue reading that advances only on true completion. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed continue reading not restoring the last chapter position, and details not resuming from loaded chapters. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed strip follow jitter, right-to-left drift, loading collapse, short-page centering and the paged chrome toggle. — @Thunderhawkk
Made favorites, chapters and sections load lazily so large libraries scroll far more smoothly. — @Thunderhawkk

sections.heading: Discovery and detail pages
items: Added curated film lists including the National Film Registry, AFI 100, Sight and Sound, the Criterion Collection and major festival winners, with accolade badges on cards.
Added country browsing with per-country canons, notable people and tiles, plus a Born Today row.
Added a criticism panel, production facts, camera and format details, adaptation rows and soundtrack rows to detail pages.
Added filmography grouping and completion tracking, and a shared crew line between two people.
Added a relationship graph that explains why titles are connected.
A festival badge now names the prize it won rather than leaning on the curator line.
Title matching is stricter, so a sequel marker or a colon continuation no longer passes as the same film, and short common-word titles are treated as risky.

sections.heading: Speed and efficiency
items: Watchlist grids are virtualized per date group, so very large watchlists scroll smoothly. — @Thunderhawkk
Proxied images are resized on the server with a thumbnail cache, and cover thumbnails are kept on disk and can be cleared by hand. — @Thunderhawkk
Requests for the same thing are now shared instead of duplicated, and a prefetch skips anything already resolved or already being fetched.
Closing a page now cancels the work it started, and a late reply from cancelled work can no longer populate a cache or resurrect a stopped session.
Feeds render progressively as each source answers, rather than holding everything for the slowest.
Caches are now size-bounded with real expiry, so stale, future-dated or malformed entries cannot hide fresh data.
A slow provider now hits its deadline without discarding the data that already arrived.
Artwork downloads stop at a size limit without relying on the server reporting a length, and an unmeasured poster is no longer downgraded.
Live TV responses are bounded and cancellable, so a slow or endless source can no longer hang the page.

sections.heading: Plugins and extensions
items: Fixed extension archives being fetched as text instead of bytes, which corrupted every download. — @Thunderhawkk
Added the extension API members measured as missing, plus CloudflareKiller and several Android system stubs, so far more extensions load. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed V-Cloud, Pixeldrain and Supervideo link resolution. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the compatibility layer failing to build from folder paths containing spaces. — @Thunderhawkk
Gave plugin checks the same timeout as playback and warmed the bridge before a deadline starts. — @Thunderhawkk
An addon outage is now told apart from a cancelled request and from a real error, so a healthy source is not marked broken.

sections.heading: Interface and navigation
items: Added in-place sidebar editing with hide, reorder and a hidden tray, replacing the separate Manga and Live TV hide toggles. — @Thunderhawkk
Added the MinUI Dark theme preset with a token-driven dock. — @Thunderhawkk
Added per-cache storage usage in the Caches tab so you can see what is using space. — @Thunderhawkk
Kept sidebar menus measurable and immediately dismissible. — @Talal1011
Fixed rows not re-measuring cards after switching card style. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed TV cards using blurred posters instead of real anime backdrops. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed poster dock clipping at row boundaries and header action overlap. — @O1Abdulrahman
Fixed stray focus rings in search and made Tab stay inside the overlay. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed F6 tearing down pane focus, and focus restore borrowing page-level rounded corners. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the clock overlay being hidden in windowed mode.
A fractional interface zoom no longer lifts the dock off the bottom of the window.
Pages no longer scroll past the end of the list they belong to, and a zoomed or panned view now counts its own offset instead of pushing content upward.
Hover and keyboard controls now meet a 44 pixel pointer target and reveal on focus as well as hover.

sections.heading: Playback and platform
items: Fixed a Linux race by creating the mpv render context before loading the file. — @kalashnikxvxiii
Native power inhibition is now preferred on Cinnamon and GNOME, so the screen no longer sleeps during playback. — @anmol210202
Fixed watchlist same-name collisions, duplicate ghost entries and anime details hijacking the wrong title. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed metadata addons installed through a Stremio account not being detected. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the cache clear confirmation resetting before the clear ran. — @AnessBen
Improved HDR session handling and the overlay stage across providers.
Windows playback now serializes start and stop separately from property polling, so a quick stop and start no longer trips over itself.
DRM, local tracks and unsupported cast protocols no longer trigger native playback on a receiver.
Cancelling a cast load no longer mutes or plays the local picture before the stop is acknowledged.
Cancelling a download now removes the partial file and its entry instead of leaving a stub behind.
A provider key that hits a quota error is treated as a failure, while an entitlement error no longer rejects the key everywhere.

sections.heading: Mobile and TV
items: We are still working on mobile and TV apps. We have no ETA but we appreciate and value all feedback given for the circulating TV betas.

0.9.127.title: Compass Beta 0.9.127
0.9.127.intro: A focused update for Windows HDR playback, window startup, and embedded subtitle selection.

sections.heading: What's in this one
items: Fixed the extra Compass loading window during True HDR embedded playback on Windows.
Fixed the thin light line at the bottom of Compass when reopening maximized with Windows taskbar auto-hide enabled.
Fixed automatic embedded subtitle selection when track information arrives late. With Prefer embedded subtitles enabled, matching embedded tracks take priority over external results.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Thank you for the reports and for testing these fixes. Please check HDR playback, reopening Compass maximized, and automatic subtitle selection on your setup. If an issue returns, include your version, Windows display settings, and clear steps in our Discord support channel. Hide private links and account details before sharing. — Talal

0.9.126.title: Compass Beta 0.9.126
0.9.126.intro: Account, playback, subtitle, and browsing improvements, with more reliable name saving and session handling.

sections.heading: Accounts and sessions
items: Improved Compass display-name saving, retry handling, and account isolation.

Added proactive Compass session renewal and a single retry for eligible requests after an expired session. Temporary connection failures preserve your saved session; revoked sessions still require sign-in.

sections.heading: Playback and subtitles
items: Fixed the Windows player startup background and cleanup of Compass's RTX filter when switching between eligible SDR and HDR sources.
Fixed subtitle text remaining visible after selecting Off, including late subtitle events.
Included seeking, Windows audio recovery, and content-advisory updates.

Load custom mpv scripts before player initialization and open the separate Windows player on Compass's display (#1422). HDR display restoration still needs device-specific verification, especially in separate-window mode.
Improved subtitle pop-out placement and prevented duplicate subtitle overlays while it is open.
Improved playback statistics: unavailable drop counters no longer appear as a measured zero. This is not a universal fix for fullscreen stuttering.

sections.heading: Browsing and retained changes
items: Improved Discover loading and scrolling behavior.
Updated settings layouts and profile-background previews, and added the subtitle-FPS icon to the icon collection.
Added custom screensaver videos, GIFs and images, richer Voyage hover details, and corrected settings-search destinations.
Improved anime Continue Watching deduplication and Bleach TYBW episode labels. Added offline retry queues for Trakt and Simkl progress, isolated by Compass profile (#1421).
Retained the approved Continue Watching and plugin updates, along with earlier beta and experimental fixes.
These version-specific release notes remain available offline after installation.

sections.heading: Request security
items: Improved provider domain checks, including public suffixes and shared hosting domains.

sections.heading: Please test
items: Save a display name, reopen settings, and restart Compass. Confirm the saved name and sign-in remain.
Check a failed save while offline, then reconnect and retry. A failed save must not report success.
Check account actions after real session renewal without signing in again. Offline recovery and expiry retry have passed simulated tests; live verification is still pending.
Turn subtitles Off while a line is visible, seek, then turn them on again. Check that no old line stays on screen.
On Windows, switch from SDR playback with RTX enabled to HDR and back. Check the picture, seeking, audio, and fullscreen.
Finish an episode offline, reconnect, and check tracker history. Switch profiles and confirm pending progress does not move to the other profile.
Check custom screensaver playback, subtitle pop-out open/close, settings search, and separate-window placement on a second monitor.
Report problems through Compass's official Discord support. Include your version, platform, steps, and expected result. Remove passwords, tokens, and private URLs from anything you share.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Thank you for helping improve Compass. Please try the features you use every day and tell us if anything feels different. If something goes wrong, note what you were doing, your Compass version, and your operating system. For playback issues, include whether HDR, RTX, or fullscreen was enabled. Clear steps and a short recording help us investigate. Please hide passwords, tokens, and private links before sharing. — Talal

0.9.125.title: Compass Beta 0.9.125
0.9.125.intro: Playback, subtitles, Continue Watching, navigation, and library improvements brought forward from Experimental 0.0.3 and 0.0.4, together with the latest approved beta changes.

sections.heading: Playback, subtitles, and X-Ray
items: Fixed Arabic/English subtitle identity and grouping, and preserved manual Live Try timing through seeking and pause/resume.
Improved encrypted HLS playback to address repeated segment stalls (#1400).
Improved Windows audio-output switching and recovery (#1334), and restored window bounds and maximized state after leaving fullscreen (#1394).
Select an X-Ray actor to browse their movies and TV shows without leaving the player.
Added Linux MPRIS desktop media controls for playback, seeking, volume, and metadata (#1372).

sections.heading: Continue Watching and your library
items: Dismissed cards can return when you make further progress, including progress from Trakt and Simkl. Improved external-source refresh and retained shared-profile safeguards (#1411, #1359).
Added optional episode-still artwork for Continue Watching, with your saved frame as a fallback. This preference is off by default (#1411).
Season selection follows watch progress (#1401).
Added drag-and-drop list reordering (#1361) and descriptions for custom and featured lists (#1371).

sections.heading: Navigation and appearance
items: Improved TV/controller navigation across settings, settings focus, and home search (#1408).
Improved Arabic/RTL navigation in Big Picture, the poster dock, and live TV multiview (#1406).
Restored the standard row arrows while retaining navigation fixes. Liquid Glass arrows are unchanged.
Restored ElegantFin sidebar collapse and Back alignment (#1399).
Refreshed the content advisory popup with translucent styling and updated animations. Removed the migration that automatically enabled content advisories.
Updated studio/network facts: removed average-rating/runtime facts and display an IMDb score for the featured acclaimed title when available.
Added a custom background and dimming control for the Who's watching screen.

sections.heading: Books, manga, and more
items: Added full Edge TTS voice discovery for ebooks (#1409).
Included manga downloads, browsing/extension improvements, and AniList/MAL progress tracking (#1385).
Included desktop notifications (#1398) and controller cursor toggle, idle auto-hide, and input-yield options (#1362).
Experimental release notes remain available after installation, including offline. Beta 0.9.125 includes its own bundled changelog fallback.
Updated regression coverage for navigation, subtitles, release notes, Continue Watching, and background controls.

sections.heading: Account changes
items: Discord account sign-in, linking, and recovery have been removed. Discord Rich Presence is separate and remains available.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Sorry for the delay, everyone, and thank you for your patience. The stable release will be published soon. Thank you to every tester, developer, and contributor helping us improve Compass.

sections.heading: Credits
items: Credits: Thunderhawkk, uddx7, O1Abdulrahman, anmol210202, pengunnn, OwaisByte, kalashnikxvxiii, Talal1011, and the Compass contributors.
